The most powerful zuhras draw followers and elemental metal with overwhelming force of personality and literal magnetism. When called upon to conduct _wish_ rituals, they use their long isolation from the other planes as an excuse to misinterpret requests outlandishly, claiming linguistic differences. **[Recall Knowledge - Elemental](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)** ([Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=2), [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=10)): DC 36 **[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 34 **[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 31 [Zuhra Shuyookh](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2656) **Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 161 **Perception** +23; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=12) **Languages** [Common](/Languages.aspx?ID=1), [Talican](/Languages.aspx?ID=112); [_truespeech_](/Spells.aspx?ID=340) **Skills** [Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) +27, [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +24, [Crafting](/Skills.aspx?ID=4) +26, [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=5) +26, [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=7) +24, [Performance](/Skills.aspx?ID=12) +28, [Society](/Skills.aspx?ID=14) +22 **Str** +5 **Dex** +6 **Con** +8 **Int** +5 **Wis** +4 **Cha** +7 **Items** _+2 [striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=280) [spiked chain](/Weapons.aspx?ID=60)_ --- **AC** 34 **Fort** +29 **Ref** +23 **Will** +21 **HP** 212 **Resistances** [electricity](/Traits.aspx?ID=56) 10 **Conductive Redirection** ([arcane](/Traits.aspx?ID=11), [concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [electricity](/Traits.aspx?ID=56)) **Trigger** The zuhra is hit by an attack, spell, or effect that deals electricity damage; **Effect** The zuhra conducts the electricity through their body, taking damage as normal, and redirecting a bolt at one target within 30 feet that they can see. The zuhra makes a ranged attack roll with a +27 modifier against the target's AC. On a hit or critical hit, the target takes electricity damage equal to the full damage of the triggering effect.
**Magnetic Field** ([arcane](/Traits.aspx?ID=11), [aura](/Traits.aspx?ID=206), [metal](/Traits.aspx?ID=505)) 10 feet. All squares in the aura are [difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=453) for creatures wearing metal armor or made of metal. Strikes with metallic weapons made by or against creatures in this aura take a –2 status penalty to the attack roll. Zuhras ignore these effects. --- **Speed** 30 feet, fly 35 feet **Melee** _spiked chain_ +27 ([Disarm](/Traits.aspx?ID=175), [Finesse](/Traits.aspx?ID=179), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [reach 15 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192), [Trip](/Traits.aspx?ID=196)), **Damage** 2d8+11 slashing plus 1d12 electricity **Melee** hand blade +25 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [Finesse](/Traits.aspx?ID=179), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [reach 15 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192)), **Damage** 2d4+11 slashing plus 4d4 [persistent bleed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29) **Arcane Innate Spells** DC 32, attack +24 - **Cantrips (7th)** [Detect Magic](/Spells.aspx?ID=66) - **5th** [Invisibility](/Spells.aspx?ID=164) (×2), [Magnetic Acceleration](/Spells.aspx?ID=943) (at will), [Magnetic Attraction](/Spells.aspx?ID=944) (at will) - **6th** [Mercurial Stride](/Spells.aspx?ID=1374), [Wall of Metal](/Spells.aspx?ID=1379) - **7th** [Clad in Metal](/Spells.aspx?ID=1366) (can choose uncommon and rare metals), [Enthrall](/Spells.aspx?ID=104), [Plane Shift](/Spells.aspx?ID=222) (at will; to [Astral Plane](/Planes.aspx?ID=8), Elemental Planes, or the [Universe](/Planes.aspx?ID=1) only), [Weapon Storm](/Spells.aspx?ID=373) - **Constant (5th)** [Tongues](/Spells.aspx?ID=340) **[Change Shape](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=8)** ([Arcane](/Traits.aspx?ID=11), [Concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [Polymorph](/Traits.aspx?ID=127)) The zuhra transforms into a Small or Medium metal elemental or animal. This doesn't affect the zuhra's statistics, but it could change the damage type of their Strikes. **Magnetic Reposition** ([Arcane](/Traits.aspx?ID=11)) **Frequency** once per round; **Effect** The shuyookh targets any number of creatures affected by their magnetic field, and [moves](/Rules.aspx?ID=451) each target 10 feet in a direction the zuhra chooses. Each target can resist being moved if it succeeds at a DC 32 Fortitude save. **Magnetic Storm** ([Arcane](/Traits.aspx?ID=11)) **Requirements** The shuyookh's magnetic field is active; **Effect** The shuyookh electromagnetically flings razor-sharp metal scraps. Each creature in a 30-foot emanation takes 8d6 slashing damage and 3d12 electricity damage, with a DC 32 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Fortitude save. The shuyookh's magnetic field is deactivated for 1d4 rounds. **Mercurial Wish** ([Downtime](/Traits.aspx?ID=49)) **Frequency** three times per year; **Effect** The shuyookh conducts a _wish_ ritual for the benefit of a mortal, requiring no cost or secondary casters. The shuyookh's result is a success if they succeed at a DC 5 flat check or a failure if not. The shuyookh attempts to fulfill the wish in a way that creates an unstable or impermanent benefit.
